title: fullyConnectedLayer
summary: Create a fully connected layer compatibility object.
description: `fullyConnectedLayer(outputSize)` returns a RunMat Deep Learning Toolbox compatibility object with layer metadata and common name-value properties.
behaviors: `Name` and `Description` are stored as layer properties.
Additional common layer name-value options are preserved as properties for layer graph construction.

example.input:
layer = fullyConnectedLayer(outputSize)
layer = fullyConnectedLayer(outputSize, Name, Value)

gpu_residency: Layer construction is host metadata work and has no provider kernel.
